title: Using softwares to formulate and manage project

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply financial functions to evaluate project financial efficiency, select investment options, and perform sensitivity analysis.
Understand and apply project management concepts using Microsoft Project software, including planning, resource management, and cost control.
Utilize Excel for financial modeling, reporting, and project visualization.
Utilize Microsoft Project for project planning, resource allocation, and monitoring.
Develop independent learning and research skills, as well as the ability to identify and solve problems.
Work effectively in groups and complete team tasks.
